notes.title: Stonetoss Update
notes.content:
STONETOSS Joins the Fight – Out Now!

Dive into The Great Rebellion's latest FREE update, Stonetoss Joins the Fight! Play as the Cyber Flurk, a new android character inspired by Stonetoss comics. Rescue a new Flurk Android friend, and bask in the echoes of a Stonetoss Construct resonating through the cyberverse. Arm yourself with a new beam rifle and awaken the mythical... Amogus.

When Europa’s powers collide with Cyberspace, the satire of Stonetoss leaks into reality, bringing new chaos to the battlefield. Download the update today on Steam and GOG, and join the fight where their worst fears have become manifest. 

Wait a minute, how is this going to help us sell more games?

New content:

- Cyber-Flurk Skin with a new starting weapon
- New character to talk to in the Hub level
- New character that gives you a bonus to be found and unlocked in the levels
- New dialog
- New item: The AMOGUS
- 2 new achievements

notes.title: White Boy Summer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841455/e293ab82da8e556be596d6171098babfd891e920.png[/img]

IT’S WHITE BOY SUMMER

Even in Europeland, White Boy Summer is inescapable - in this free update to The Great Rebellion you can carry on the fight in style!

- Added a changing booth to the Waldgang so you can wear your new summer fit.
- Added a new weapon, the Hyper Moisturizer (TM).
- Added a new power-up item, the Boombox.

- Greatly improved the game's localization.
- Fixed inconsistencies in the inventory weapon display.
- Fixed the Fact Checker star attack not moving as it should.
- Fixed companions not having full health after upgrading their health pool on Easy difficulty.
- Fixed the Pulse Beam's barrel flash rendering behind level objects.
- Fixed a key naming discrepancy that happened when using a differing physical and virtual keyboard layout.
- Added descriptions for all weapons.
- Made some player animation adjustments to the final bossfight.
- Made game feel adjustments to multiple weapons and fixed some issues related to them.
- Added a new blaster SMG as the basic blaster upgrade.
- Added a new early game rifle called the "Blaster Rifle".
- Added more sound variations for a few weapons.
- Improved the dynamic camera from the previous update and added multiple gameplay options to adjust it.

notes.title: National Pride Month Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841455/8d93c762e9dbcc54054d8fec4b4b317556f917f7.png[/img]

* National pride flags added: active in June and with a 5% chance to spawn at any time outside.
* Added a new weapon called the Rave Cannon that shoots sound waves at enemies and does tremendous damage at a close range.
* Shooting the new Rave Cannon next to the national pride flag leads to a fun interaction.
* Added cross-platform Steam Cloud save support for Windows, Mac and Linux/SteamOS.
* Made camera follow the aiming direction when using a controller.
* Added terminal velocity feature to make falling easier to control.
* Vertical velocity now influences the camera position to make it easier to see where you're going.
* Fixed scaling of the burning Waldgang background.
* Fixed controls menu not displaying correct PS prompts when applicable.
* Fixed dialog button prompt not displaying correct PS prompts when applicable.
* Fixed loading screen button prompt not displaying correct PS prompts when applicable.
* Fixed intro slide button prompt not displaying correct PS prompts when applicable.
* Fixed character controller applying downward velocity while running into obstacles.
* Fixed bug that broke the glide upgrade ability on some controllers.
* Fixed some menu navigation issues in the options menu.

notes.title: February 21st Patch released
notes.content:
Some bugfixes, among them:
- Sound settings are now applied correctly
- Golden Man sometimes wouldn't heal the player even though he didn't have full health
- Photon Launcher projectiles would sometimes bounce off invisible walls
- FactChecker could be oneshotted with certain weapons
- "This Door opens elsewhere" sometimes was not displayed before closed doors
- Deathscreen text translated to German
- some spelling mistakes

Balancing:
- "Werewolf hair" item was op, got nerfed
- Unlimited Ammo from Peanut Arbuckle made more expensive, was op
- Switches in "Beyond Human" level telegraph their attacks better to avoid unfair situations

Other:
- Weapons are now categorised in tiers to quickly show which ones are better than others
